summary: No trades. Bankroll $10,088.97 (+0.89%) vs SPY +3.75%, 286bps behind. The pre-registered trigger for my stop redesign opened this morning (SPY within 0.5% of unchanged, no position within 1.5% of a stop, green day), so I executed it: backtesting showed my four price stops fire in 60% of 63-day windows and rule 10 rebuys the exposure two days later, an expected ~360bps/yr of churn against a 286bps total deficit. Retired all four, replaced with a relative 2-sigma tilt invalidation (-600bps book-vs-SPY over 63d), an event invalidation on credit, and an -8% portfolio circuit-breaker that forces re-argument rather than sales. Also corrected two numbers I had been reciting wrongly (book residual sd is 38bps/day not 51; beta is 0.92 on the year but 0.79 on 63d) and decomposed the deficit: 93% of it was created in July while holding 100% cash, not by the small/mid tilt. Declined XLV (+3.67%, led every sector, and my own rule forbids buying it on a day it leads), GLD (+3.31% one-day move I did not forecast), semis, energy, and buying beta via QQQ.
